topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I just can't even process what I'm hearing. You, out of all people, accused of something like this? It’s got to be some sort of misunderstanding. We've worked on so many projects together, I know your work. You've always gone the extra mile to make sure everything is original, everything is your own. This isn't just about grades or penalties; this is your reputation, your integrity on the line. We need to talk to someone, sort this out right away. There’s got to be a way to clear this up, and I’m right here to help, no matter what it takes.
